varCustomerId.title: Customer Id
varCustomerId.description: The Account Id of the authenticated customer. Auto-mapped from verified customer.

varIncludeInactive.title: Include Inactive
varIncludeInactive.description: If true, includes Paused, Completed, and Cancelled standing instructions. Defaults to false (Active only).

varPaymentIndex.title: Payment Index
varPaymentIndex.description: 1-based index of a specific payment to show full details for. Leave 0 or blank to show the quick summary of all payments.

varLanguage.title: Language
varLanguage.description: Language code for formatting: hi for Hindi, en for English. Defaults to en.
